profile.headline: Partner & CTO at KABI Automotive
profile.summary: Web and software developer with over 15 years experience crafting online experiences. I have worked in a broad range of problem domains ranging from automotive operations to usage based billing platforms.

positions.title: Partner & CTO
positions.description:
• Own design and development of patented SaaS products used by auto dealerships nationwide
• Manage mission-critical cloud infrastructure and build  tooling to maximize development velocity
• Championed security initiatives, leading the organization through SOC2 certification
• Contribute to the overall product direction balancing customer feedback and business goals

positions.title: Managing Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Technical and career coach for multiple cross-disciplinary engineering teams
• Interpret company vision and product requirements into understandable, executable work 
• Coordinate and unblock development across multiple different functional teams
• Work with team members to define and measure career development and growth goals
• Represent the team to stakeholders including executive leadership, product, design and others

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Design and build systems for usage metering, cost estimation, and platform REST/GraphQL APIs
• Instrument and improve resiliency of Kafka producers and services distributing platform data
• Help form strategically critical team and drive legacy billing extraction to vendor platform
• Mentor and onboard engineers through pairing, technical workshops, and organizing game days
• Lead automation and access control improvements to reduce team toil and secure internal tools

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Reduced costs by migrating third-party dependencies to AWS equivalents
• Built REST microservices for custom email templating and delivery
• Mentored several interns and on-boarded new developers
• Served as a Technical Lead of the backend platforms team

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with stakeholders including President, CTO, Ops Managers, and Field Technicians
• Developed software to streamline billing management, project scheduling, and fleet tracking
• Leveraged Twilio to create unique telephone survey and employee trainings

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Created response to RFPs, SOWs, and proof-of-concepts to secure bids
• Built web and mobile software using primarily Ruby on Rails and React
• Helped migrate existing and legacy websites to new applications
• Deployed and managed infrastructure for clients and customers

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Converted designs to semantic HTML and CSS
• Met and worked with clients to produce project estimates and timelines
• Used PHP/MySQL to create highly customized web apps for a variety of industries
• Used frameworks like WordPress and Codeigniter to speed up development
• Used jQuery to improve user experience and ease of use
• Handled minor linux and apache server maintenance
• Managed DNS setup and changes for new websites
